name: Meteoric-Maw
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
the signal of unknown origin bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever controls exotic matter controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
